subject.title: [Feature]: No way to view/manage paired contacts & permissions

question: Should OpenClaw add a broad paired-contact/permissions inventory surface, a narrower pairing-management CLI, or keep management in existing `/allowlist` and manual/doctor paths?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the feature exposes and may mutate authorization state, overlaps an open narrower pairing-management issue, and needs a decision on command naming, metadata, redaction, and whether group permissions belong in the same surface.

options.title: Unify contacts and pairing admin
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical product surface and design account-scoped list/revoke/status behavior that also resolves the narrower pairing-management request.

options.title: Approve narrow pairing CLI
options.body: Add `pairing list-approved` and `pairing revoke` with JSON output, focused tests, docs, and explicit redaction while leaving last-active and broader permissions for later.

options.title: Keep existing controls
options.body: Document `/allowlist list/remove --store` and pairing store paths as the supported management flow, and decline a new terminal inventory for now.

recommendation.title: Unify contacts and pairing admin
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the canonical product surface and design account-scoped list/revoke/status behavior that also resolves the narrower pairing-management request.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant history includes `/allowlist` and pairing CLI work, and the remaining blocker is a product-boundary decision across overlapping admin surfaces.
